description: The Jellyfin Enhanced banner, shortcut check, import line and switch-off checklist on Bookmarks' settings page, in the je sandbox: Bookmarks' settings page shows, from the server's JellyfinEnhanced and JeImport Diagnostics entries and as text, the overlap banner while Jellyfin Enhanced's Bookmarks is on, the warning when the bookmark shortcut is a key jellyfin-web or JE takes, under the shortcut field (je-switchoff-probe.mjs sets BookmarkNowShortcut to B for one run), the Data tab's import line, and once every JE user with bookmarks is covered by an applied import (the gate: a dry run doesn't count; with no JE bookmarks there is nothing to wait for) the switch-off checklist with each item ticked as the server sees it, the shortcut steps last, and 'Use B for bookmarks' once JE's B is durably off for everyone (shown disabled, with the server's reason, while B is free only until a restart or a switch); before that the gate's line instead of the checklist, and no 'Use B'. The expectations come from the Diagnostics the page reads, so the check holds in every state the probes put the sandbox in.

steps.name: sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics
the JellyfinEnhanced entry: JE installed, the Bookmarks overlap, our shortcut checked
steps.assert: (e => !!e && e.Installed === true && !!e.Overlap && e.Overlap.Feature === 'Bookmarks' && Array.isArray(e.Overlap.Checklist) && e.Overlap.Checklist.length === 8 && Array.isArray(e.OurShortcuts) && e.OurShortcuts.length === 1 && e.OurShortcuts[0].Name === 'BookmarkNow')(__vars.diagnostics.JellyfinEnhanced)

steps.name: what the server says
steps.eval: (e => ({ on: e.Overlap.On, banner: e.Overlap.Banner, canUseB: e.Overlap.CanUseB, note: e.Overlap.UseBNote, items: e.Overlap.Checklist.map(i => [i.Key, i.Done, i.NeedsRestart]), shortcut: e.OurShortcuts[0].Combo, warning: e.OurShortcuts[0].Warning, jeKey: e.Shortcuts.BookmarkCurrentTime, users: e.UserShortcuts.map(u => [u.Name, u.Overrides.BookmarkCurrentTime]) }))(__vars.diagnostics.JellyfinEnhanced)

steps.name: the JeImport entry: the gate
steps.eval: (g => ({ ready: !!g && !g.Error && g.ChecklistReady === true, users: g ? g.UsersWithBookmarks : null, pending: g && g.Pending ? g.Pending.map(p => p.UserName || p.JeUserId) : [] }))(__vars.diagnostics.JeImport)

steps.name: open Bookmarks' settings page
the page rendered its Diagnostics (the checklist is filled in, or the gate's line shown)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); if (!p) return false; const items = p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhancedChecklist li').length; const gate = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeChecklistGate'); return __vars.gate.ready ? items === 8 : (items === 0 && !!gate && !gate.classList.contains('hide') && gate.textContent.length > 0); })()

steps.name: the settings are loaded: the shortcut field has the saved shortcut and its check is under it
what the page shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const banners = Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksBanners .bookmarksBanner')).map(b => ({ cls: b.className, text: b.textContent, children: b.children.length, shortcut: b.getAttribute('data-shortcut') })); const items = Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhancedChecklist li')).map(li => ({ key: li.getAttribute('data-key'), done: li.getAttribute('data-done'), text: li.querySelector('span').textContent, detail: (li.querySelector('.fieldDescription') || {}).textContent || null, html: li.querySelectorAll('b, i, a, img').length })); const gate = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeChecklistGate'); const check = p.querySelector('#BookmarksShortcutCheck'); const warn = check.querySelector('.bookmarksShortcutWarning'); const imp = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImport'); return { check: check.textContent, checkWarning: warn ? { text: warn.textContent, shortcut: warn.getAttribute('data-shortcut'), children: warn.children.length } : null, field: p.querySelector('#BookmarkNowShortcut').value, gateShown: !gate.classList.contains('hide'), gateText: gate.textContent, importShown: !imp.classList.contains('hide'), importStatus: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportStatus').textContent, dryRunDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeDryRun').disabled === true, applyDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeApply').disabled === true, sectionShown: !p.querySelector('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhanced').classList.contains('hide'), banners, items, useB: !p.querySelector('#BookmarksUseBRow').classList.contains('hide'), useBDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksUseB').disabled === true, note: p.querySelector('#BookmarksUseBNote').textContent, noteHtml: p.querySelector('#BookmarksUseBNote').children.length }; })()

steps.name: the section shows while JE is installed
the Data section's import line follows the gate: nothing to import, who waits, or imported; Import disabled before a dry run
steps.assert: __vars.shown.importShown === true && __vars.shown.applyDisabled === true && (__vars.gate.users === 0 ? (__vars.shown.importStatus.indexOf('Jellyfin Enhanced has no bookmarks on this server') === 0 && __vars.shown.dryRunDisabled) : __vars.gate.pending.length > 0 ? __vars.shown.importStatus.indexOf('Not imported yet: the Jellyfin Enhanced bookmarks of ' + __vars.gate.pending.join(', ') + '.') === 0 : __vars.shown.importStatus.indexOf('Imported') === 0)

steps.name: the checklist shows exactly once the import has run (the gate); before that the gate's line, as text
steps.assert: __vars.gate.ready ? (!__vars.shown.gateShown && __vars.shown.items.length === 8) : (__vars.shown.gateShown && __vars.shown.items.length === 0 && __vars.shown.gateText.indexOf("This checklist shows once Jellyfin Enhanced's bookmarks are imported above") === 0)

steps.name: the overlap banner is the server's sentence, shown exactly while JE's Bookmarks is on
the shortcut's check is under its field: the server's sentence while our key is reserved or invalid, else that it is free or off; no banner for it

the checklist's items, ticks and details are the server's, as text, in its order: JE's Pages tab boxes first (12.11 and 12.12 alike: Add the Custom Tabs entry for me first, Enable Bookmarks Feature last), the shortcut steps last, the admin's worded the way JE's Keyboard tab sets it: 12.11's Key field and Add, or 12.12's grid of keys, which takes no text, its key named by its place at the left end of the row (since 1.1.1)
steps.assert: !__vars.gate.ready || (JSON.stringify(__vars.shown.items.map(i => [i.key, i.done === 'true'])) === JSON.stringify(__vars.server.items.map(i => [i[0], i[1]])) && __vars.shown.items.every(i => i.html === 0 && i.text.indexOf(i.done === 'true' ? '\u2713 ' : '\u2610 ') === 0) && JSON.stringify(__vars.shown.items.slice(-2).map(i => i.key)) === '["ShortcutAdmin","ShortcutUsers"]' && JSON.stringify(__vars.shown.items.slice(0, 4).map(i => i.key)) === '["BookmarksAutoCreateCustomTab","BookmarksUseCustomTabs","BookmarksUsePluginPages","BookmarksEnabled"]' && __vars.shown.items.slice(0, 4).every(i => /^. Jellyfin Enhanced's settings page, Pages tab, Bookmarks: /.test(i.text)) && (((v) => v.length < 2 || v.some(isNaN) || v[0] > 12 || (v[0] === 12 && v[1] >= 12))(String(__vars.diagnostics.JellyfinEnhanced.Version || '').split('.').map(Number)) ? (/Keyboard tab, click the key [(]B[)] at the left end of the Bookmark Current Time row, press another key combination, such as Shift[+]X, then Save Settings; never Delete or the ⊘ button beside the key [(]Disable for every user[)], never a blank key [(]Backspace puts B back[)]/.test(__vars.shown.items[6].text) && !/Disabled/.test(__vars.shown.items[6].text)) : (/Keyboard tab, choose Bookmark Current Time in the list of shortcuts, type Disabled into the Key field and click Add/.test(__vars.shown.items[6].text) && /never its Disable button, never a blank key/.test(__vars.shown.items[6].text))) && !/Shortcuts:/.test(__vars.shown.items[6].text))

steps.name: Use B for bookmarks is shown exactly while the import has run and the server says B is durably free (enabled) or withheld with a reason (disabled, the server's note as text), and ours isn't B yet
open the Data tab and bring the section into view
bring the banners into view
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider while JE's Custom Tabs sync runs, excepted)
